content:
mira: Kicked off a focused GPTQ bakeoff across Llama/Mistral/Qwen — goal is to measure instruction-following sensitivity and long-context KV-cache behavior. Posting config and quick results as they come.

sam: Awesome — are we using the same eval suite as last time (instr-hf + longctx-story + math)?

mira: Yes. instr-hf for instruction deltas, longctx-story for KV/cache, and truthfulness/math probes from eval-bucket v3. Config:
```
- models: [Llama-2-70B, Mistral-7B, Qwen-7B]
- recipes: [gptq-4bit-base, gptq-4bit-chunked-kv, awq-8bit, fp8-compat]
- kv-testing: 1k/2k/4k sequence lengths, repeated-prefix stress tests
- decode: sampling top_p=0.95 temp=0.2 for open ended; greedy for QA
- dataset splits: small-sample smoke (100), full (5k)
```

alex: Ran smoke on Llama-2-70B (gptq-4bit-base) — instr-hf delta vs FP16: -0.8% avg (some instructions worse by ~2.1%). KV at 4k shows weird token repetition after 2.2k, looks like cache indexing drift.

jin: I triggered gptq-4bit-chunked-kv for Llama-2-70B on the cluster (job id l70b-g4c-041). I/O logs attached to job, but summary: chunked-kv removes repetition, instr delta improves to -0.3%.

eval-bot: Auto results added -> /evals/1727654329/run-01/summary.json (metrics: instr_hf/EM/acc, longctx/perplex, truthfulqa/score).

sam: Mistral-7B gptq-4bit-base finished: instr delta -1.5%, QA EM -1.9%. AWQ-8bit gave smaller model-size but a bigger instr drop (-2.2%). FP8-compat not stable yet (OOM on our 48GB nodes).

mira: Qwen-7B results? Prior notes showed Qwen is sensitive to per-channel scales during GPTQ; watch out for outlier layers.

alex: Qwen-7B gptq-4bit-base: instr delta -0.4%, but longctx-story at 4k shows degraded coherence (score down 3.1%). Tried per-layer re-clamp on attention -> coherence recovered ~1.8 points.

jin: Quick numeric rollup (smoke, instr_hf delta vs FP16):
- Llama-2-70B: gptq-4bit-base -0.8%, gptq-4bit-chunked-kv -0.3%, awq-8bit -1.1%
- Mistral-7B: gptq-4bit-base -1.5%, awq-8bit -2.2%
- Qwen-7B: gptq-4bit-base -0.4%, per-layer clamp -> -0.1%

mira: Noted patterns: 1) chunked-kv helps Llama-2 long-context behaviour, 2) Mistral is more instruction-sensitive to quant noise than the others, 3) Qwen benefits from per-layer dynamic range fixes.

sam: Action items before full run:
- Add chunked-KV variant for Mistral (to see if same fix helps).
- Try GPTQ calibration with 2x more samples for Mistral attention layers.
- Add a monitor that flags coherence drop at >2k tokens in longctx tests.

alex: Ops note: 48GB A100s OOM on Llama FP8 compile. For full runs we'll use 80GB nodes or split per-shard compilation. ops-bot scheduled extra capacity for 1727654400-1727658800 window.

ops-bot: Reserved 3 x 80GB nodes for eng-ml bakeoff window (ids: n-803, n-804, n-805).

jin: Quick experiment log snippet that helped debug Qwen clamp: 
```python
# computing per-channel clamp thresholds
scales = abs(weight).mean(axis=1)
clamp = np.percentile(scales, 98)
weights = np.clip(weights, -clamp, clamp)
# re-run quantizer with same num-calib samples
```

mira: Plan: run full 5k evals with these variants + per-layer clamp and chunked-KV tweaks. We'll compile a final rollup and propose a deployment profile:
- Llama-2-70B: gptq-4bit-chunked-kv as default for long-context products, fallback awq-8bit for cost-sensitive low-context routes.
- Mistral-7B: hold on gptq-4bit until more calibration; consider awq-8bit with aggressive eval gating.
- Qwen-7B: gptq-4bit with per-layer clamp for instruction routes.

sam: I'll own the full-run orchestration and perf dashboards. Alex/Jin please add short reproducible scripts and attach to the run folder.

alex: Uploaded run orchestration + minimal repro to /runs/1727654329/orchestration.tar.gz

mira: Thanks — we'll reconvene after full-run completes (ETA ~6h). If anyone spots a 4k coherence drop during the run ping me with sample id and job id. :mag_right:

sam: noted. :white_check_mark:
